raw.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As Director of Fraud Strategy, you will own Imprint's fraud prevention outcomes across new account fraud, first-party fraud, and transaction fraud. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for fraud losses, team performance, and the strategic direction of fraud controls at Imprint.

You will serve as the default fraud expert at Imprint — the internal thought partner for the fraud team and the authoritative voice on fraud strategy across the broader organization. This role blends deep technical fluency with cross-functional leadership, requiring someone who can operate at the rule level when needed and influence at the executive level consistently.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Full command of Imprint's new account and transaction fraud controls, with the ability to research individual rules and field ad hoc questions or escalations independently

  • Demonstrated ability to update fraud rules — used as a proxy for sufficient operational context

  • A clear, evidence-backed point of view on the primary blockers to delivery speed (e.g., org structure, tooling, capacity, empowerment, or budget)

  • Substantive feedback delivered on the current fraud strategy vision for the next 6–9 months

  • Established as a trusted fraud authority across the fraud team and key cross-functional partners

Responsibilities

  • Own fraud loss outcomes across new account fraud, first-party fraud, and transaction fraud, with full accountability for team performance and strategic direction

  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of three direct reports — fraud leads across new account, first-party, and transaction fraud domains

  • Serve as the internal expert and thought partner for fraud strategy, both within the fraud team and across the broader organization

  • Define and evolve Imprint's fraud controls framework, balancing speed of delivery with operational complexity

  • Partner closely with modeling, engineering, and senior leadership to align on fraud priorities and resource trade-offs

  • Champion the most valuable fraud initiatives through clear storytelling and internal advocacy

  • Navigate fast-paced, cross-functional communication with clarity and precision

  • Act as an operational backstop in high-severity fraud scenarios, with the depth to engage directly when needed

  • Surface and communicate fraud risk, strategy, and performance to executive stakeholders in a compelling, accessible way

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated track record of owning fraud loss outcomes as a non-individual contributor across a major product area — minimum 3 years in a people leadership role with direct P&L or loss accountability

  • Deep expertise in fraud prevention, with hands-on experience across multiple fraud domains (e.g., new account fraud, transaction fraud, first-party fraud)

  • Industry background in money movement — fintech, banking, payments, or similar environments where financial fraud is the core scope

  • Technically proficient: able to write or read code (SQL, SAS, Python, or equivalent), even if not actively coding in the role

  • Comfortable with how machine learning models work and how they integrate into fraud decisioning

  • Clear and compelling communicator with the ability to influence across teams and levels

  • Detail-oriented with the operational depth to serve as a backup resource in a fraud incident scenario

  • Skilled at navigating trade-offs and prioritizing high-impact strategic initiatives in a fast-moving environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with credit or debit card fraud controls

  • Experience with transactional controls frameworks

  • Background building or scaling fraud functions in high-growth or early-stage environments

  • Familiarity with cross-functional fraud tooling and rule management platforms

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $225K - $250K

raw.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

  • Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

raw.description:
Part-Time Career Coach (Flexible, Paid Workshop + Upside)

About CourseCareers

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without a college degree or prior experience.

We work with industry professionals to create job-focused courses that teach practical, employer-aligned skills in technology, business, trades, and operations. Our students are career changers looking for realistic, entry-level opportunities — and coaching helps bridge the gap between coursework and landing the job.

About the Role

We’re looking for part-time Procurement Career Coaches to support students through live workshops and optional 1:1 coaching.

This is not a traditional employment role and not a guaranteed-income position. It’s a flexible, paid opportunity best suited for professionals who want to mentor, teach, and build a small coaching practice on the side — with upside if students choose to work with you.

How This Role Actually Works

  • You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

  • You are paid $50 for your workshop + Private business you acquire

  • Ability to receive exclusive coaching offers if you prove your abilities

  • Workshops are used to provide value, answer questions, and showcase your expertise

  • If students choose to book you for 1:1 coaching, you keep the coaching revenue

  • You set your own availability and working hours

There is no requirement to convert students, workshops are paid regardless, but conversion is where upside comes from.

Responsibilities

  • Host a live, one-hour workshop, on a monthly basis

  • Answer student questions related to the field and job search

  • Share real-world insight into what entry-level roles actually look like

  • Provide optional 1:1 coaching to students who request it

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience in the field

  • Interest in mentoring and helping career changers

  • Strong communication and teaching ability

  • Availability at least three evening per week, ideally Tuesday–Thursday

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable running your own workshops

Ideal Fit

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Enjoy teaching and mentoring

  • Want flexible, side income

  • Like the idea of being paid to teach — with optional upside

  • Don’t need guaranteed hours or full-time income

Compensation

  • $50 per one-hour workshop (One per month guaranteed)

  • Unlimited upside from 1:1 coaching sessions you convert

  • No caps, no quotas, no minimums

raw.description:
About the Role

This is a backend engineering role at the heart of a fintech team building compliance and identity infrastructure for businesses. You will design scalable, high-trust systems and help shape the engineering culture of a senior, distributed team solving a genuinely hard technical problem.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build backend systems that are clean, testable, and efficient.

  • Architect scalable APIs and infrastructure suited to high-trust, regulated environments.

  • Bring strong opinions on testing, quality, and long-term maintainability to every project.

  • Tackle complex product challenges by thinking deeply about user needs and system behavior.

  • Shape engineering practices and technical culture through collaboration and hands-on leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years of backend engineering experience building production APIs, distributed services, or backend systems; the team skews toward 7+ years.

  • Strong systems thinking: ability to see beyond individual features and reason about large-scale architectural problems.

  • Experience building in high-trust or regulated domains such as fintech, payments, or identity.

  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar) in production.

  • Experience with message queues or event-driven architectures (RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar).

  • Experience deploying and managing applications in containerized or cloud environments (Kubernetes, AWS, or similar).

  • A track record of writing automated tests and maintaining testable codebases.

  • Familiarity with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, and Event Sourcing patterns is a plus but not required.

  • Background at a high-caliber fintech, payments, or high-growth technology company is a strong signal.

  • Clear communicator who enjoys breaking down complexity and collaborating closely with teammates.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and driven by curiosity, big ambitions, and kindness.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: EUR 116,000 to 146,000, applied consistently at each level with no individual salary negotiation. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Fully remote, open to candidates in European timezones. European timezone availability is a hard requirement. The team meets in person every six weeks for a company-wide gathering.

raw.title: Sales Development Representative
raw.excerpt: Koyfin is a fast growing fintech company building a powerful, intuitive analytics platform used by financial advisors and individual investors to research ideas, manage portfolios, and grow their businesses.
raw.description:
Koyfin is a fast growing fintech company building a powerful, intuitive analytics platform used by financial advisors and individual investors to research ideas, manage portfolios, and grow their businesses. We believe every investor deserves world-class research tools without the complexity or price tag of legacy platforms.

Our impact so far:

🚀 One of the fastest-growing platforms for financial advisors, driven by product-led growth
🥇 Recognized by users as a top-rated investment solution on G2
🏆 Rated as the top research platform for user satisfaction in the Kitces survey, the largest survey in the advisor industry

About the Role

Koyfin has over 60,000 financial advisors using the platform and over 800,000 registered users. Most of them found us on their own. Your job is to turn that product-led momentum into revenue by reaching the right advisors at the right moment and booking qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

You'll be one of our first in-house SDRs, joining a lean sales org. You own the human side of outreach: research, calls, and LinkedIn. You'll run time-boxed tests across a 45-day multi-touch journey of calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

This is a ground-floor seat. Every motion here has defined success and quit criteria, and what you learn on the phones directly shapes how we build and scale the team.

What You'll Do

This role is for someone who is competitive, hungry and here to win. We set aggressive goals and we’re looking for people who want to beat them. The pace is fact, the work is hard. If that energizes you, you’ll fit in.

  • Run high-quality outbound calls and LinkedIn outreach to users and new registrants

  • Qualify prospects and book meetings for Account Executives, with clean, well-documented handoffs

  • Work with RevOps on prospect lists, targeting, and sequencing

  • Research prospects (advisors, RIAs, and IBD reps) using product-usage signals and firm data

  • Log every activity in HubSpot so the team can measure what's working

  • Share what you hear from the market (objections, use cases, competitor mentions) to sharpen messaging and targeting

  • Carry a revenue-based quota tied to pipeline you source that converts to closed-won business

What We're Looking For

  • 1 to 3 years of experience as an SDR or BDR, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a track record of hitting or beating quota

  • Comfortable on the phone: you like calling and can hold a real conversation with a busy professional

  • Experience with multi-channel outreach (phone, email, LinkedIn) and a CRM (HubSpot a plus)

  • Strong written and verbal communication, and the discipline to keep a CRM clean

  • Curious, coachable, and energized by testing and iterating rather than running a fixed script

  • Interest in markets and investing. Experience selling to financial advisors, RIAs, or financial services is a plus, not required

  • Able to start immediately and work hybrid from or near Great Neck, NY / NYC

Why Join Koyfin

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Career Path: Early SDRs get direct coaching from the Head of Sales and a clear line of sight into how the team grows.

  • Innovative Environment: Be part of a fast-growing company at the forefront of financial technology, moving quickly to release new products.

  • Dynamic Culture: Customer First, Humility & Respect, Teamwork, Continuous Improvement, and Getting Things Done.

  • Impactful Work: Work with a small, talented team where your contributions directly impact the product and the community it serves.

  • Industry-Leading Product: Sell a product users already love, disrupting the financial analytics space through product-led growth.

  • Efficiency and Growth: Koyfin is cash flow positive and emphasizes doing more with less.

At Koyfin, impact comes with responsibility. We expect independent thinking, sound judgment, and ownership of outcomes. We value clear communication, intellectual honesty, and continuous improvement. You’ll be trusted to make decisions, contribute thoughtfully, and raise the standard of the work around you.

Our hiring process is thoughtful and efficient, typically including an HR conversation, role-specific interviews, and a final discussion with leadership.

Koyfin is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Compensation Range: $75K - $115K

raw.title: Design Lead, Credit Cards
raw.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As Design Lead, Credit Cards at Imprint, you will lead a small team of designers while owning the creative execution of co branded card programs from brief to production. This is a player coach role, you'll be hands on with design work while also guiding, developing, and setting the bar for the designers on your team.

You will act as the primary creative partner to brand and product stakeholders, translating partner briefs into compelling visual presentations, defending design rationale, and ensuring every card program reflects the brand promise of both Imprint and its partners. You'll also be responsible for the quality and consistency of your team's output, coaching them through critique and helping them grow as designers.

This role blends hands on design execution, people leadership, and program level thinking. You understand how a card fits within a digital wallet, a mobile app, and a partner's broader identity, and how to build production ready mechanicals that meet the specialized requirements of credit card manufacturing. Just as importantly, you know how to build that same fluency in the designers you lead.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Ramped on active programs and contributing meaningfully to in flight milestones such as press checks

  • Built working relationships with your team, established a rhythm for critique and feedback, and gotten a clear read on each designer's strengths and growth areas

  • Established credibility as a client facing creative, listening to partner feedback, translating briefs into visual presentations, and confidently presenting options with clear rationale

  • Demonstrated fluency in print production as it applies to card manufacturing, including mechanical builds for the printer

  • Producing work, and guiding your team's work, that reflects program level thinking: how the card design connects to digital wallet, app context, voice and tone, and the overarching brand promise

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a small team of designers, setting the creative bar and providing regular feedback and coaching

  • Own end to end creative execution for co branded card programs, from initial brief through final production, both personally and through your team

  • Lead client facing creative presentations, listening to partner feedback, presenting options, and defending design decisions with clarity and confidence

  • Translate partner briefs into card designs, program toolkits, and visual systems that reflect brand identity, voice and tone, and program promise

  • Build production ready mechanicals for card manufacturing, ensuring files meet the specialized requirements of credit card print production

  • Manage program level creative thinking across card design, digital wallet, and app contexts, for your own work and your team's

  • Collaborate closely with cross functional stakeholders across brand, product, and external partners

  • Maintain quality and consistency across all creative deliverables throughout the program lifecycle

  • Participate in production milestones including press checks and printer coordination

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated experience in brand or print design, with a strong portfolio showing end to end ownership of design projects

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or managing designers, even informally, with a genuine interest in growing people

  • Proven ability to present and defend creative work to clients or stakeholders, articulating design rationale across multiple options

  • Strong understanding of print production, including how to prepare and build mechanicals for commercial printing

  • Experience operating at a program level, understanding how a single design asset connects to a broader brand system

  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to translate feedback into actionable creative decisions, for clients and for your team

  • Comfort working directly with external partners or clients in a fast paced, deadline driven environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with credit card or financial product design, including knowledge of card manufacturing processes and specifications

  • Familiarity with digital wallet and mobile app design contexts

  • Experience building creative toolkits and brand systems, beyond individual asset execution

  • Background in co branded or licensed design programs where multiple brand identities must coexist

  • Prior experience as a design lead or manager of a small team

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

raw.title: HubSpot Systems & Data Engineer
raw.excerpt: About UsCurvion is a high performance RevOps & sales augmentation agency that installs and deploys enterprise-grade, AI-driven revenue engines and selling systems for our clients.
raw.description:
About Us

Curvion is a high performance RevOps & sales augmentation agency that installs and deploys enterprise-grade, AI-driven revenue engines and selling systems for our clients. Think of a lead generation based marketing agency…. But focused on sales! We design and install complete sales systems from sales processes and GTM strategy to CRM setup all the way to fully outsourced sales engagements. Then we enhance those systems with AI enabled tools and battle tested playbooks, and finally, we provide highly trained sales talent to help our clients execute so their revenue engine runs faster, scales efficiently, and performs consistently. In short, we build and power modern, AI-driven sales systems that help companies grow with clarity and control.

Position Overview: HubSpot Systems & Data Engineer

The HubSpot Systems & Data Engineer is the person who makes sure the infrastructure underneath our clients' sales operations actually works.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role centered around HubSpot architecture, data integrity, automation, integrations, reporting, and system performance. You’ll work across multiple client environments, identifying problems, building solutions, cleaning up messy systems, and creating infrastructure that can scale.

This is not a CRM admin role where you occasionally create a property or fix a contact record.

We’re looking for a legitimate HubSpot and data nerd who enjoys getting into the weeds. Someone who can look at a complicated CRM environment, understand what is happening under the hood, find what is broken, and build a better way.

This is an agency role. You’ll work across multiple clients, each with different sales processes, systems, data structures, and business requirements. Experience working in a client-services environment is critical.

Ideal background: HubSpot Solutions Partner, HubSpot agency, RevOps agency, CRM consultancy, or similar technology/implementation agency.

You SHOULD apply to this role if:

  • You have agency, consultancy, or client-services experience

  • You’ve preferably worked for a HubSpot Solutions Partner, HubSpot agency, RevOps agency, CRM consultancy, or similar organization

  • You have configured and optimized HubSpot environments for multiple clients

  • HubSpot is basically your playground

  • You understand CRM architecture, objects, properties, pipelines, workflows, automation, and data structures

  • You’ve worked with integrations, APIs, webhooks, dialers, schedulers, reporting tools, or other sales technology

  • You’re obsessive about clean, accurate, usable data

  • You enjoy troubleshooting why data isn't behaving the way it should

  • You can walk into a messy HubSpot account and quickly identify what needs to change

  • You understand how CRM data impacts reporting, attribution, forecasting, and sales execution

  • You’re comfortable managing multiple client environments simultaneously

  • You’d rather fix the root cause than keep patching the same problem every week

  • You enjoy documenting systems so other people can actually understand and maintain them

You SHOULD NOT apply to this role if:

  • Your HubSpot experience has primarily been as an end user

  • You’ve only managed a single internal CRM environment

  • You have no agency, consulting, or client-services experience

  • You don't enjoy working across multiple client environments

  • "Data hygiene" sounds painfully boring to you

  • You prefer strategy without getting into the technical weeds

  • You aren't comfortable troubleshooting integrations and system issues

  • You don't care whether the underlying data is accurate as long as the dashboard looks good

  • You need someone else to tell you exactly what to build

Core Outcomes

  • HubSpot environments are clean, scalable, and intentionally structured

  • CRM data is accurate, reliable, and usable

  • Workflows, automations, and integrations operate as intended

  • Data issues are identified and resolved before they become operational problems

  • Reporting and downstream data systems receive reliable CRM data

  • CRM architecture and standards remain consistent across client environments

  • New client systems are deployed with strong technical foundations

  • System documentation accurately reflects the environments we operate

General Expected Duties

  • Build, configure, and optimize HubSpot properties, objects, pipelines, workflows, automations, and system architecture

  • Audit client HubSpot environments for data quality, structural issues, and operational inefficiencies

  • Identify and resolve CRM data integrity issues

Role Title: Senior Metallurgist / Welding Inspector

Role Type: Contractor

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least 8 years of hands-on experience making high-stakes accept/reject calls on micrographs, weld macros, fracture surfaces, coatings, or LPBF additive builds.
  2. Advanced knowledge of US and international standards including ASTM, AMS, AWS, NADCAP, NACE/AMPP, and SSPC.
  3. Current or prior AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) credentials, or equivalent metallurgical certification.
  4. Proven experience in metallographic analysis, heat treatment evaluation, weld inspection, and industrial coating assessment.
  5. Familiarity with additive manufacturing processes, especially laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) and associated defect mechanisms.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to explain technical reasoning clearly.

raw.title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
raw.excerpt: The job in one lineYou run the CEO's operating system: goals, cadence, and follow-through.
raw.description:
The job in one line

You run the CEO's operating system: goals, cadence, and follow-through. You also personally own the projects that don't have a home yet.

Everyday Dose is moving fast in a lot of directions at once. The constraint isn't ideas or effort. It's making sure the right handful of things get set, tracked, and actually finished while everything else keeps running.

That's this job. It is not an executive assistant role and it is not a note-taking role. You'll own outcomes, run the meeting the leadership team is accountable to, and have a real seat.

What you'll actually do

Own goal setting. Run quarterly and annual planning end to end. Sit with each exec, turn intent into targets that are measurable and few. Hold the line when a goal is a paragraph instead of a number. Publish it so the whole company knows what we're playing for.

Manage against those goals. Goals decay the week after they're written unless someone owns them. You're that someone. You track progress, surface slippage early, and escalate the things that need the CEO before they become fires.

Run the weekly leadership meeting. Set the agenda, bring the numbers, drive to decisions. Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and you chase them down between meetings. You're not the scribe; you're the person who makes the hour worth everyone's time.

Keep the scoreboard honest. Build and maintain the company-level reporting leadership runs on, in partnership with finance and data. Numbers come from the warehouse, not from someone's recollection on a call. If two sources disagree, you're the one who reconciles them.

Run special projects. The high-stakes, cross-functional thing that has no owner: a new bet, a partnership, a channel or business we're deciding whether to enter, a problem that spans three teams and belongs to none of them. You get handed ambiguity and come back with an answer, a model, and a plan.

Be the CEO's second read. Pressure-test decisions before they're made. Prep board and investor materials. Write the memo when the thinking needs to be sharp. Say the thing nobody else in the room will say.

What success looks like in 90 days

  • Company goals for the quarter are written, owned, and measurable, and every leader can recite theirs without opening a doc
  • The weekly leadership meeting has a repeatable format, a live scoreboard, and decisions that stick
  • One company-level dashboard everyone trusts, sourced from the warehouse
  • Two special projects taken from ambiguous to finished without supervision
  • The CEO's time visibly reallocated toward the highest-leverage work in the business

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 8 to 12 years of experience, including time as a Chief of Staff, BizOps lead, Strategy & Operations lead, or equivalent to a founder/CEO or a senior exec
  • Top pedigree. Strong academic background and time at companies with a known high bar, plus a record of being promoted inside them. We look hard at both.
  • Left brain. You're fluent in a spreadsheet and comfortable in a data environment. You can build a model, size an opportunity, read a cohort curve, and pull your own numbers rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
  • Right brain. You write exceptionally well. Memos, board decks, exec comms. You can take a messy 90-minute discussion and turn it into one page that changes what people do.
  • You've run an operating cadence (OKRs or equivalent, weekly business reviews, planning cycles) at a company doing real volume, not as a theory from a deck.
  • Backbone. You will regularly tell senior, accomplished people that their goal isn't measurable or their project is late. You do it without drama and without flinching, and they respect you for it.
  • Startup metabolism. High ambiguity, fast context switching, nothing beneath you. You'd rather own the outcome than protect the org chart.
  • You use AI tooling daily to move faster on analysis, drafting, and research.


Bonus

  • DTC, subscription, or CPG experience, especially a business with recurring revenue and real retention mechanics
  • Consulting, banking, or PE foundation plus real operating experience (we're not looking for one without the other)
  • You've built materials for and presented to a board or investors
  • SQL, or enough of it to be dangerous

What this role is not

  • Not an executive assistant. You are not managing a calendar or booking travel.
  • Not a project manager who takes notes and updates a tracker
  • Not a strategy role that stops at the recommendation
  • Not a functional leadership role. You won't inherit a team on day one, though this role can grow into one.

If you want a clear lane and a stable scope, this isn't it, and that's fine.

How to apply

Skip the cover letter. Instead, send us:

  1. One page on an operating cadence you built or ran. What existed before, what you changed, and what measurably improved as a result.
  2. A time you told an executive something they didn't want to hear. What you said, and what happened.
  3. Short answer: A subscription business is seeing retention slip. Five executives each have a confident, different theory as to why. You have two weeks. What do you look at first, how do you get to the actual answer, and how do you land it with a leadership team that's already made up its mind?

We read these carefully. Applications without them won't move forward.

Benefits

  • Strong base, performance bonus
  • Meaningful equity because we want you to own a piece of what you build
  • Health benefits + health stipend
  • Generous time off
  • Free product

raw.description:
For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

Our Human Service Team is seeking a Senior Underwriting Specialist to add to their growing team in Central Zone.

This is a full time, exempt role either a hybrid or remote setting.

Position Overview Responsible for identifying, soliciting, underwriting and selling new and renewal Middle Market accounts that drive profitable growth and align with the Human Services Industry segment, appetite and mix goals. Apply advanced technical, sales and analytical skills to provide insurance solutions that help Hanover’s customers manage risk. Demonstrates a thorough understanding of Hanover’s strategies and Human Services appetites and will use internal and external data to make appropriate individual and portfolio Human Services risk decisions. Operates within a broad Letter of Authority for all underwriting decisions and with limited direction while managing an assigned book of business, generally with high technical complexity and coordination. Willingness to build and foster key agency relationships, identify emerging issues, obtain competitive intelligence and engage in industry-specific continuing education.

Key responsibilities Technical Underwriting

  • Knows and applies advanced underwriting concepts including risk selection, exposure and hazard identification and control, coverage implications, and loss analysis.
  • Uses all appropriate underwriting tools (e.g. RQI, WC RST, UWWS, and CLAY.), disciplines and knowledge of strategies to ensure underwriting guidelines are followed.
  • Advanced knowledge of pricing components and rating methodology and correlates pricing to exposure, financial and competitive analysis.
  • Completes file documentation according to best practices guidelines and state regulations and can clearly explain account decisions.
  • Adheres to CAT guidelines and underwriting discipline to minimize exposure and appropriately price individual risks. Applies increased knowledge of CAT aggregation to decision making.

Portfolio Management & Financial Acumen:

  • Manages assigned portfolio to achieve gross written premium, profitability, rate, retention, industry and LOB mix, new business and portfolio management goals.
  • Reviews key metrics and uncovers trends that may lead to new business opportunities with agents while achieving profitable growth in accordance with business strategies.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the market factors and trends that can affect pricing (i.e. distribution channels, competition, organization’s growth/ profit strategy, regulation, reinsurance costs and branding).
  • Prepares or analyzes information on adverse underwriting decisions, rate appeals, underwriting requirements, status and declinations in order to drive results within the assigned territory.
  • Supports the implementation of profit improvement initiatives with key agents.

Sales Acumen & Customer Advocacy:

  • Can identify, solicit, pipeline, negotiate, and close accounts aligned with MM branch strategy. Ability to profile assigned agency plant and to strategically market our capabilities to agents.
  • Operates with a franchise perspective to identify and drive enhanced sell opportunities and create growth within other lines of business and customer segments. Utilize our value proposition to enhance agency economics, partner conversion and product specialization in partnership with local management.
  • Prioritizes and drives effective relationship management and producer activities to build trust, facilitate negotiation, and secure commitment in order to improve yield and retention ratios.
  • Keeps current on state/territory issues, regulations and trends. Utilizes market and competitor information to enhance agent relationships by becoming a trusted advisor.
  • Through stewardship process engage at the customer level for the most complex and prominent accounts within their territory.
  • Independently implements territory business plans, monitors performance, adjusts plan to ensure a substantial pipeline for future profitable growth.
  • Makes sales presentations to agents and customers on a regular basis and participants in more complex accounts:

◦ Utilize Industry Solutions partners to augment sales process through enhanced knowledge transfer, strategic producer visits/sales calls, and effective training sessions for both agents and customers. ◦ Effectively utilize Claims, Risk Solutions and Operations to display service and/or technical expertise to build confidence in customers to further secure business opportunities.

Core Competencies, Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
  • 5-7+ years Underwriting experience, with a minimum of 3 years of experience underwriting MM accounts.
  • 5+ years of experience driving agency relationships resulting in profitable new and renewal business.
  • May specialize /certify in one or more Industry Segments.
  • Acts as a change advocate, and is open to new and different ways of thinking.
  • Communication (verbal and written) - Interacts and communicates with confidence with all levels of external and/or internal business partners within scope of responsibility, team and/or matrix environment. Can judge appropriate means and method to communicate based on the nature of the communication. Able to influence desired outcomes to drive actions and results. Adept at influencing even when holding a position contrary to the majority opinion.
  • Judgement and Decision Making - Ability to exercise judgment, negotiate and make sound business decisions based on level of authority. Applies judgment and expertise to determine when escalation is needed. Demonstrates confidence in one’s ability to apply decision making to UW assessment.
  • Agile and Adaptive - Strong ability to identify, analyze and solve problems as well as the ability to learn rapidly, adapt quickly to change, exercise influence, and manage and prioritize multiple concurrent projects.
  • Team work and Collaboration – Consistently fosters collaboration and respect among team members. Easily adapts to the diverse interests, styles and perspective of key players. Is able to engage multiple members of a group to share information and to consider other points of view to reach objectives, consensus and/or deadlines.
  • Experienced in working with a wide range of teams and readily shares lessons learned.
  • Informal Leadership - Viewed as an informal leader amongst the team/branch/region/LOB. Open to and proactively shares knowledge and expertise with peers, management and leadership. Acts as a mentor for less experienced underwriters or newly hired underwriters, may assist with training other team members. Is used as a resource by others to collaborate on more complex risks, pricing, trends, industry segments coverages and product knowledge. May conduct peer-to-peer self-audits under the direction of management.

CAREER DEVELOPMENT:

It’s not just a job, it’s a career, and we are here to support you every step of the way. We want you to be successful and fulfilled. Through on-the-job experiences, personalized coaching and our robust learning and development programs, we encourage you – at every level – to grow and develop.

BENEFITS:

We offer comprehensive benefits to help you be healthy, build financial security, and balance work and home life. At The Hanover, you’ll enjoy what you do and have the support you need to succeed.

Benefits include:

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Virtual Medical Receptionist, Medical Scheduler, or Patient Coordinator supporting U.S. healthcare practices.
  • Previous experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience verifying insurance eligibility and understanding PPO and HMO plans.
  • Strong knowledge of referral management and appointment scheduling.
  • Excellent English communication skills (Spanish is a plus).
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Comfortable handling patient interactions with professionalism and empathy.

Preferred Experience

  • Referral Coordination
  • Insurance Eligibility Verification
  • Appointment Scheduling
  • Patient Outreach
  • Medical Reception
  • Healthcare Customer Service

Equipment Requirements

  • Dedicated, quiet home office suitable for HIPAA-compliant work.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection.
  • Windows computer with dual monitors preferred.
  • Backup internet connection is highly preferred.

Benefits

Please note that this is a full-time contractor position (40 hours per week) with a negotiable pay rate depending on skillset and experience. The schedule is Monday through Friday, from 8 AM to 5 PM CST.

raw.description:
Payments Product Manager (US, Remote)

Our client, a high-growth consumer subscription company, is hiring a Payments Product Manager to own their payments platform end to end. This is not a greenfield build. You inherit a modern stack — a first-party payments microservice, a payment orchestration layer routing across processors, BNPL, automated dunning, and a self-serve analytics layer — plus a dedicated engineering scrum team. Your job is to push it forward.

Two priorities define the first six months. First, rebill recovery: a meaningful share of subscription rebills fail, and too many of those customers churn for payment reasons, not product reasons. You'll audit the dunning stack, evaluate vendors, and decide whether to optimize, switch, or layer. Second, initial auth rate: routing optimization, network tokenization, express checkout, and continuous experimentation at the checkout layer.

In a given week you'll write a spec, pull your own numbers out of the data warehouse, negotiate a vendor SLA, and present findings to the CFO. There is no payments ops team behind you. When something breaks, you drive resolution. You set the roadmap, you ship, you measure.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in payments product or payments program management, subscription or e-commerce
  • Hands-on experience with payment orchestration platforms and multi-MID routing
  • Dunning and recovery expertise: retry logic, involuntary churn metrics, vendor evaluation
  • Data self-sufficiency in modern BI tools — you don't wait on an analyst
  • Demonstrated AI-native workflow: you actually use LLM and agentic tools in your product work today. This is a minimum qualification, not a preference.
  • Comfortable owning chargebacks, fraud posture, and regulatory compliance context

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Unlimited PTO, plus company holidays
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • HSA and FSA options; Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet insurance and commuter benefits (state specific)
  • Company equipment provided

raw.description:
We are seeking an experienced, consultative Sales Executive who can understand a client’s larger business goals, uncover their most important challenges, and connect those challenges to the right marketing, sales, and technology solutions.

This is not a transactional sales role. The right candidate knows how to ask thoughtful questions, identify the pain behind the initial request, and demonstrate how our services can help the client generate measurable business results.

You should be comfortable discussing HubSpot Marketing Hub, HubSpot Sales Hub, SEO, AI search visibility, digital marketing, and business automation with executives and decision-makers. You do not need to personally implement every solution, but you must understand these services well enough to confidently communicate their strategic value.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery calls with business owners, executives, marketing leaders, and sales leaders.
  • Understand each prospect’s business model, goals, growth challenges, sales process, and marketing performance.
  • Uncover the prospect’s underlying pain points, not just their surface-level requests.
  • Recommend solutions that align with the client’s priorities, budget, goals, and desired outcomes.
  • Clearly communicate the value of:
    • HubSpot Marketing Hub
    • HubSpot Sales Hub
    • CRM implementation and optimization
    • Marketing and sales automation
    • Search engine optimization
    • AI search visibility, AEO, and GEO
    • Content strategy and lead generation
    • Sales and marketing alignment
    • Reporting, attribution, and performance optimization
  • Manage inbound and outbound sales opportunities from initial contact through closing.
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders and navigate complex B2B buying decisions.
  • Conduct presentations, solution demonstrations, and strategy conversations.
  • Develop proposals, scopes, pricing recommendations, and follow-up communications.
  • Maintain accurate contact, deal, activity, and pipeline information in HubSpot CRM.
  • Use Apollo for prospecting, contact research, outreach, and account development.
  • Collaborate with marketing, strategy, and delivery teams to create the right solution for each client.
  • Use Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to improve research, call preparation, follow-up, proposal development, and overall sales productivity.
  • Consistently meet or exceed pipeline, activity, and revenue goals.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in B2B consultative sales, solution selling, or agency sales.
  • Formal sales training or demonstrated experience following a structured sales methodology.
  • Strong discovery skills and the ability to ask meaningful, sometimes challenging questions.
  • Ability to connect a client’s business goals and pain points to practical solutions.
  • Working knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, AI search, lead generation, and marketing automation.
  • Experience selling or discussing HubSpot Marketing Hub and Sales Hub.
  • Hands-on experience managing contacts, companies, deals, tasks, and activities within HubSpot CRM.
  • Experience using Apollo or a comparable sales intelligence and prospecting platform.
  • Comfortable communicating with business owners, executives, and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, follow-up, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical or marketing concepts in clear business language.
  • Highly organized, accountable, and consistent with CRM and pipeline management.
  • Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to streamline work while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Sandler sales training or certification is a strong plus.
  • Experience selling digital marketing, HubSpot, SEO, AI, SaaS, consulting, or professional services.
  • HubSpot certifications in Sales Hub, Marketing Hub, Inbound Sales, or related areas.
  • Understanding of AI search platforms and how AEO/GEO differs from traditional SEO.
  • Experience creating proposals, forecasts, sales reports, and executive presentations.
  • Familiarity with multi-touch sales cycles involving several stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

About Us:

TMB is the community-driven entertainment company engaging more than 250 million consumers worldwide across streaming TV, social media, web, and print. Our portfolio of brands including FailArmy, Family Handyman, People Are Awesome, Reader's Digest, Taste of Home, The Healthy, and The Pet Collective, is powered by content that's inspired and created by our fans. Learn more about our brands, our data-driven marketing solutions, our award-winning licensing services, and much more at trustedmediabrands.com.

Location:

We have offices in New York, Los Angeles, Milwaukee, and Gurgaon. This position will be based in the United States and can work remotely.

About the role:

TMB is looking for a Director of Data Science & AI to lead the team and efforts to turn data into decisions, deliver scalable intelligence that drives personalized experiences and business outcomes, and lean into AI and Automation where it makes sense. You understand how business users think, what friction looks like in real workflows, and how to communicate technical solutions in ways that land with non-technical users.

Your primary mission is to bridge the gap between what’s technically possible and what’s practically useful. This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll set the technical direction, but you’ll also be in the data, in the model reviews, and building alongside your team when it counts. We need someone fluent in Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Vertex AI, and broader GCP ecosystem), has strong data science capabilities and the grit to take ideas from research to production.

You are a fast learner who is comfortable in ambiguity, energized by solutioning, and motivated by seeing your work drive real adoption across the organization. You'll spend your time championing smarter ways of working and helping both technical and non-technical teammates integrate AI into their everyday work, not as a disruption, but as a natural extension of how they already operate.

Your day-day: (aka Responsibilities)
  • Own the data science roadmap for the organization from core statistical modeling and experimentation forecasting, segmentation and applied AI where it adds real business value
  • Lead, mentor, and stay hands-on with a small team of data scientists: writing code and reviewing methodology, not just roadmaps
  • Oversee the design of robust, production-grade solutions utilizing core cloud systems, vector databases, and agentic workflows
  • Champion the adoption and continuous improvement of AI development tools across technical teams
  • Scale MLOps/LLMOPs practices, ensuring data observability, governance, model safety, and ethical AI compliance
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Development, and Product teams to drive technical innovation, prioritize initiatives, ship MVPs fast and iterate based on usage data
  • Design and run rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses and guide business decisions
  • Translate statistical and technical work into business language for executive stakeholders and make the case for where data science investment should go next
  • Define success metrics for internal tools and AI initiatives, and track adoption, usage, and business impact over time
  • Document tools, workflows, and best practices to scale impact beyond individual engagements
  • Stay informed on industry trends, viral content, and emerging platforms to identify new opportunities
You have: (aka Qualifications)
  • 7+ years in data science, including leading or managing a technical team
  • Strong foundation in core data science
  • Deep, hands-on fluency in Google Cloud Platform: BigQuery, Vertex AI, and building/deploying production models in a GCP environment
  • Proficiency deploying custom Gemini Enterprise Agents via Agent Engine
  • Fluency in AI tools such as Claude, CoPilot and ChatGPT
  • Strong Python and SQL skills and experience in applied AI
  • A bias for action
About this team:

The Data Science team is a small but mighty group sitting at the center of the organization. We're a centralized team, which means we work across nearly every department: from Marketing and Creative to BI, Engineering, Product, and beyond. If there's a workflow to improve, a tool to build, or a data problem worth solving, chances are we're involved.

Our work is practical by design. We build internal tools and data products that make real work easier, not to chase trends, but because the right solution at the right moment can meaningfully change how an entire team operates. We use AI where it genuinely helps, and we're skeptical of hype for its own sake. That pragmatic instinct is part of what makes us effective.

As a team, we move fast and stay scrappy. We're not a big org with lengthy approval chains. We prototype, iterate, and ship. We collaborate constantly, both within the team and across the business, and we're at our best when we're working alongside stakeholders to understand their problems firsthand rather than solving in a vacuum.

If you're joining us, you're joining a team that values curiosity, initiative, and craft. Our team genuinely believes the most impactful data work happens when technical depth meets real business context.

Our Benefits:

We value our people and offer a collaborative and engaging culture. As a Trusted Media Brands employee, you will enjoy work/life balance, generous time off and comprehensive benefits and programs. Learn more about what life is like working at Trusted Media Brands at

Trusted Media Brands embraces inclusivity and values our diverse community. We are committed to building a team based on qualifications, merit and business need. About Us

By transitioning from a traditional B2B publisher into a modern data authority, Life Science Connect is redefining industry standards. We specialize in constructing dedicated platforms, identity frameworks, and intelligence layers engineered to speed up development for life sciences experts. Our strategic investments in decoupled modern architecture and AI-enhanced engineering workflows empower our teams to rapidly deploy scalable, premium-quality products.

The Mission
We are seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst who excels at bridging product strategy, engineering, data, and AI-augmented development.
Forget traditional requirements-gathering roles that focus heavily on meeting notes and passing off tickets. In this position, you will be deeply integrated into a high-velocity engineering organization, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, DevOps, and UX to turn strategic concepts into precise, actionable technical architectures. As a force multiplier for the engineering team, you will decode complex business challenges into clear, implementation-ready specifications, utilize AI tools to expedite analysis, and maximize the time engineers spend writing code rather than untangling ambiguity.

Why This Role Matters

As Life Science Connect evolves into a modern data authority, our ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality depends on exceptional product definition and technical clarity. The Senior IT Business Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring engineers spend their time building innovative solutions—not deciphering requirements.
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, partnering closely with engineers, embracing AI as a productivity multiplier, and helping shape the next generation of intelligent digital products, we'd love to meet you.


What You'll Actually Do

  • Translate Strategy into Engineering Execution: Partner with Product Leadership and Engineering to transform strategic initiatives into clear technical requirements, user stories, workflows, APIs, and acceptance criteria that engineers can immediately build from.
  • Drive AI-Augmented Analysis: Use modern AI tools to rapidly produce requirements, process models, technical documentation, and data mappings while maintaining exceptional structural accuracy and logical consistency.
  • Design Intelligent Product Workflows: Analyze complex business processes and design scalable workflows that leverage identity, personalization, analytics, AI services, and customer intelligence across our product ecosystem.
  • Own Product Specifications: Produce implementation-ready documentation including PRDs, functional specifications, user stories with rigorous acceptance criteria, API contracts, process flows, and data mappings.
  • Partner Deeply with Engineering: Work directly alongside Full Stack Engineers to clarify requirements, answer implementation questions, refine technical solutions, and remove ambiguity before development begins.
  • Enable Data Intelligence: Collaborate with Data Engineering to define modern data models, ingestion patterns, warehouse requirements, reporting needs, and customer intelligence workflows while ensuring data quality throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Validate What We Build: Support testing, feature validation, and release readiness by ensuring delivered functionality aligns perfectly with business objectives and technical specifications.
  • Improve How We Work: Continuously improve documentation standards, Agile practices, AI-enabled delivery workflows, and product discovery processes to help the entire engineering organization move faster with greater confidence.


What We're Looking For

5+ Years of Business Analysis Experience

You've worked closely with engineering teams building SaaS platforms, digital products, or enterprise applications and know how to bridge business needs with technical execution.

Technical Fluency

You don't need to write production code, but you're thoroughly comfortable discussing and documenting:
  • REST APIs and JSON payload structures
  • Headless CMS architectures and decoupled front-ends
  • Identity, Authentication, and Customer Identity frameworks (CIAM)
  • Relational and modern cloud data models (Snowflake)
  • Event Tracking, telemetry, and Customer Journey Analytics
  • Cloud-based application architectures and system integrations
Experience with Next.js, React, or modern JavaScript frameworks is a strong plus.


AI-Augmented Analyst

You actively use AI to scale your daily output—not just for generating text, but as a technical sparring partner for requirements generation, gap analysis, user story refinement, edge-case discovery, and workflow optimization. You know how to engineer effective prompts, but more importantly, you possess the critical engineering mindset required to validate, audit, and correct AI outputs before they reach production teams.

Core Traits

  • Product Mindset: You naturally ask "why" before "what." You understand that every requirement should tie directly to customer value, operational efficiency, measurable business outcomes, or revenue growth.
  • Systems Thinker: You enjoy untangling complex processes, identifying hidden technical dependencies, simplifying workflows, and designing scalable architectural solutions.
  • Excellent Communicator: You can confidently facilitate alignment between executives, business stakeholders, designers, engineers, and data teams while effortlessly adapting your communication style to your audience.
  • Highly Autonomous: You excel in distributed teams where asynchronous documentation, radical ownership, proactive communication, and independent problem-solving are essential.


Preferred Experience

  • Agile/Scrum product development in highly iterative environments
  • Technical Business Analysis within cloud-native software engineering organizations
  • Headless CMS platforms (Optimizely preferred)
  • Snowflake or modern cloud-native data platforms
  • Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) systems
  • Product analytics, event streaming, and customer journey mapping
  • API integration, contract design, and webhook architecture
  • AI-assisted software delivery tools and prompts
  • Jira, Confluence, and structured ticket workflows
  • Lucidchart, Miro, or similar visual modeling tools


Success in Your First 90 Days

You'll know you're succeeding when you have:
  • Built trusted, seamless relationships across Product, Engineering, Data, and DevOps.
  • Produced implementation-ready specifications that measurably reduce engineering clarification and rework cycles.
  • Accelerated delivery velocity through high-fidelity, AI-assisted documentation and rapid analysis workflows.
  • Elevated the quality and consistency of product requirements, downstream testing logic, and acceptance criteria.
  • Contributed directly to launching customer-facing features with clear, trackable business impact.
  • Established repeatable documentation, mapping, and analysis practices that scale natively with our engineering organization.

We Invest in YOU
At Life Science Connect, our commitment to empowering innovation and facilitating growth within the life sciences sector extends to our employees. We offer a comprehensive total compensation program designed to support your overall health, financial well-being, and professional development.
In addition to a competitive salary, you'll enjoy:
● Medical/vision/prescription/dental coverage for you and your family
● 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability insurance
● 100% company-paid life insurance
● 401(k) with dollar-for-dollar company match up to 6%
● 15 vacation days and 6 personal days on day 1
● 13 company-paid holidays

To view all our job postings and showcases for some of our employees, visit:

Principals only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters or staffing agencies. No visa sponsorship is available for this position.
